sources.entry: Homepage by gethomepage - Highly customizable homepage (or startpage / application dashboard) with Docker and service API integrations. GPL-3.0 Docker/Nodejs
Homepage | Highly customisable homepage with service integrations and Docker auto-discovery

summary.one_liner: Homepage is a self-hosted application dashboard and startpage with YAML configuration, Docker label-based service discovery, and integrations for over 100 services.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a customizable web dashboard that lists your services, bookmarks, and information widgets such as weather, time, date, search, and glances. Services are configured through YAML files or discovered automatically from Docker container labels, and Docker container status and stats can be shown. Service widgets pull data from integrations with many self-hosted apps, including the *arr apps, Plex, Jellyfin, Transmission, and qBittorrent. The README says API requests to backend services are proxied so API keys stay hidden. It supports custom themes, CSS and JS, layouts, and translations into over 40 languages. Images are built for AMD64 and ARM64, and it can also be run from source with pnpm.
use_cases: startpage with service links and bookmarks
showing *arr and media server stats on one page
home page with weather and system info widgets
how_to_run: docker compose: use image ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest with HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS set, port 3000:3000, and a config volume mounted at /app/config
notable: Automatic service discovery from Docker container labels
API requests to backend services are proxied so keys stay hidden
Over 100 service integrations, including *arr apps and media servers
Optional built-in OIDC login or simple password login (opt-in)
caveats: README says that if exposed to untrusted networks it must sit behind a reverse proxy and/or VPN that enforces authentication, TLS, and Host header validation
Docker integration needs the Docker socket mounted, which the README marks as optional
Configuration details are on the external documentation site rather than in the README
keywords: show my services on one page
